Title: Delayed Sleep Phase Syndrome: 3 Habits to Reset Your Body Clock

Description:
If you can't fall asleep until well past midnight no matter what you try, it might not be insomnia — it's your body clock itself running late. Bright screens at night, sleeping in on weekends (social jetlag), and not enough morning light all push that clock later. Dimming lights before bed, waking up at the same time daily, and getting morning light can help realign it.
